messages:
mira: starting thread for 'micro-fuzz' gate idea. goal: a <5s pre-ingest check to catch tokenizer/decoding mismatches early.
dan: +1, want it lightweight and feature-flagged per-repo. we can't slow down bulk intake.
yvonne: quick asks: what exact checks? token-count stability, detokenize roundtrip, deterministic sample, and tiny perf smoke?
mira: exactly. also add a small adversarial list (unicode edgecases) and an optional customer golden-hash check (hashed+salted).
oliver: we should differentiate hard vs advisory failures. hard = token-count diff for identical codepoints, advisory = small output entropy changes.
sarah: ops perspective: surface states in Console: microfuzz:passed | advisory | blocked. add a tooltip explaining advisory => manual triage.
mira: agree. plan to store a fingerprint record in model manifest: vocab_sha256, specials_map_version, quant_format. that lets runner short-circuit identical variants.
dan: fingerprint must include quant meta (bits, layout) otherwise quantized fp32 mismatch slips through. add a field quant_label.
yvonne: job defaults: samples=12, seq_len=24, seed=1337, timeout=4s, concurrency=6. keep it low.
oliver: for determinism we lock decode params: temp=0, top_p=1, nucleus disabled, max_new_tokens=32. document this as canonical microfuzz decode.
mira: security note: customer golden sets are opt-in only. we persist only salted hashes of outputs, never raw text. Security will approve encryption flow.
sarah: automation: if microfuzz hard-blocks during pre-deploy, cancel rollout. post-deploy alerts only. no auto-rollback post-deploy.
dan: metric asks: microfuzz-flake-rate, advisory-rate, blocked-count, avg-latency. add dashboards.
yvonne: suggest a simple CLI to re-run per-model: rci microfuzz run <model> --seed 1337 --samples 24. also add a button in Console to re-run last microfuzz.
mira: small config snippet for manifest (for docs):
```
microfuzz:
  enabled: true
  samples: 12
  seq_len: 24
  seed: 1337
  hard_thresholds:
    token_count_diff: 1
    det_diff_score: 0.95
  fingerprint: {vocab_sha256: "...", specials_v: "v2", quant_label: "int8-ptq"}
```
oliver: actionable followups: 1) add fingerprint fields to model-manifest.md, 2) runner change to enforce decode params, 3) Console badge + re-run button, 4) ops playbook note for advisory triage.
dan: timeline: opt-in alpha in 2 sprints, default-on after 2 months.
sarah: i'll draft the ops playbook blurb and the Console copy for advisory vs hard blocks.
mira: i'll write the RFC patch with acceptance matrix (pass/advisory/block) and ping for review.
ops-bot: microfuzz queued for model redwood/zephyr-small at 4876543222.
ops-bot: microfuzz finished for redwood/zephyr-small: status=advisory, token_count_stable=true, det_score=0.91, golden_hash=not_provided.
dan: thanks all. will track flake metric and loop infra on runner timeouts.
yvonne: will add unicode adversarial list and share with Mira.
mira: closing thread, will post RFC link when uploaded.
